assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service is consistent with the documented diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R42.
This service directly addresses the clinical indication noted in the medical record.
This service satisfies the medical necessity criteria for the diagnostic modality in question.
